briefing.description: You departed Cedar Valley VFR and want radar advisories for the trip to Centerville. You'll make a brief initial call-up to Approach, pass your full details when they say “go ahead”, read back your squawk, and handle a radar handoff to the next sector. Rule of thumb with radar controllers: keep the first call short — just who you're calling and who you are.

steps.text: Level at 3,500 feet, 10 miles east of Cedar Valley. You tune Big Sky Approach on 126.4 and listen — the frequency is quiet.

steps.prompt: Make your initial call-up. Keep it short — just who you're calling and who you are. Details come after they answer.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your full callsign — that's the whole point of the call-up.

steps.speaker: Approach
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, Big Sky Approach, go ahead.

steps.prompt: Now pass your details: aircraft type, position, altitude, and your request (flight following to Centerville at 5,500).
steps.hint: Skyhawk {callsign} is a Cessna 172, one zero miles east of Cedar Valley at three thousand five hundred, request flight following to Centerville at five thousand five hundred.

elements.label: aircraft type
elements.feedbackMissing: Give your aircraft type — radar needs it for your data block (“Cessna 172” or “Skyhawk”).

elements.label: position report
elements.feedbackMissing: Give your position relative to a known point: “one zero miles east of Cedar Valley”.

elements.label: current altitude
elements.feedbackMissing: State your current altitude — the controller must verify it against your Mode C.
elements.feedbackWrong: You said {heard} feet, but you're level at 3,500.

elements.label: the request
elements.feedbackMissing: Say what you want: “request flight following to Centerville”.

elements.label: squawk code readback
elements.feedbackMissing: You forgot to read back the squawk code — say the four digits back so the controller can catch a mis-set transponder.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back {heard}, but Approach assigned {squawk}.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End the readback with your callsign.

steps.speaker: Approach
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, radar contact one two miles east of Cedar Valley at three thousand five hundred. Centerville altimeter {altimeter}.

steps.prompt: Acknowledge with the altimeter setting and your callsign.

elements.label: altimeter acknowledgment
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the altimeter setting — it confirms you'll be flying the correct altitude.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your callsign in the acknowledgment.

steps.text: You climb to 5,500 and cruise. Twenty miles later, Approach calls with a handoff.

steps.speaker: Approach
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, contact Big Sky Approach on one two four point seven.

steps.hint: One two four point seven, Skyhawk {callsign}.

elements.label: frequency readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the frequency — a mis-heard digit means calling the wrong sector.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back {heard}, but the new frequency is 124.7.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End the readback with your callsign.

steps.speaker: Approach
steps.text: Big Sky Approach, east sector — frequency is quiet.

steps.prompt: Check in on the new frequency with your callsign and altitude.
steps.hint: Big Sky Approach, Skyhawk {callsign}, level five thousand five hundred.

elements.label: addressing the new sector
elements.feedbackMissing: Address the facility on check-in: “Big Sky Approach”.

elements.label: your altitude
elements.feedbackMissing: State your altitude on check-in — the new controller must verify your Mode C.
elements.feedbackWrong: You said {heard} feet, but you're level at 5,500.

steps.speaker: Approach
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, radar contact. Centerville is one five miles ahead — radar services terminated, squawk VFR, frequency change approved.

steps.hint: Squawk VFR, frequency change approved, Skyhawk {callsign}. Thanks for the help.

elements.label: squawk VFR acknowledgment
elements.feedbackMissing: Acknowledge “squawk VFR” — you're confirming you'll reset to 1200.
